_schema.platform: Trait Transfer & Genome Editing Intelligence Platform
_schema.principle: Gene identity and literature references are machine-verified against NCBI Gene and PubMed. Portability, linkage drag, pleiotropy and IP remain indicative research signals curated by a breeder, not database facts.

verification_states.verified: Gene ID and at least one reference confirmed in a public database.
verification_states.partial: Gene confirmed, reference not resolved (or the reverse).
verification_states.unverified: Not yet checked, or database returned no match.
verification_states.conflicted: Database answer disagrees with the curated claim — needs human review.

Level 1.label: Commercially Validated
Level 1.desc: Verified in commercial cultivars or released products.

Level 3.label: Genetic Association
Level 3.desc: Supported by QTL, GWAS, linkage mapping, or natural allelic variation.

Level 4.label: Candidate Gene
Level 4.desc: Inferred via orthology, expression profiling, or pathway homology.

Level 5.label: Hypothesis / Research Gap
Level 5.desc: Exploratory polygenic or multi-stress target requiring functional validation.

_schema.level_derivation: A reference counts as confirmed only when PubMed matched the cited author, year and gene, or when a supplied reference resolved by its PMID. A PMID found by topic search alone does NOT count: it may be a different paper about the same gene. Level 1 is never derived — it requires a human to name a commercial cultivar or released product in corrections.json (commercial_product). Level 2 — every gene named in the entry resolves in the stated species AND a reference is confirmed. Level 3 — a reference is confirmed but gene identity is incomplete: either only some of the named genes resolve, or none of them do. Level 4 — genes resolve but no reference is confirmed: a candidate by identity only. Level 5 — neither a gene record nor a confirmed reference.

portability_tiers.t3: Transgenic / De Novo (Outside primary gene pool)

curated_references.supports: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of SlTOM1a and SlTOM3 (sltom1a/sltom3) makes tomato asymptomatic to ToBRFV, with 516-fold lower viral RNA and 25-fold lower coat protein than wild type at 12 days post-inoculation. correction.decision: Search the TOM genes under the older GenBank symbols NCBI indexes: LeTH3/TH3 and LeTH1/TH1.
correction.rationale: Confirmed in NCBI: TH3 (778361, alias LeTH3) is 'tobamovirus multiplication 1 homolog 3' on chromosome 2, and TH1 (778313, alias LeTH1) is 'tobamovirus multiplication 1 homolog' on chromosome 4. Both RefSeq proteins given in the suggestion check out: NP_001234306.1 is homolog 3 and NP_001234096.1 is homolog. The chromosomes agree with the suggested loci (SlTOM1a = Solyc02g080370 on chr2, SlTOM3 = Solyc04g008540 on chr4), which means the NCBI names run opposite to the paper's: the gene the paper calls SlTOM1a is indexed as homolog 3. Anyone editing these must key on the locus tag, not the number in the symbol.

correction.decided_by: maintainer, 2026-11-13, from an external AI suggestion (Gemini) checked against NCBI
correction.decision: Narrow this entry to ClTST2 and move ClSWEET3 and ClLCYB out of it.
correction.rationale: PMID 29118248 (Plant Physiol 2018, first author Ren Y, 'A Tonoplast Sugar Transporter Underlies a Sugar Accumulation QTL in Watermelon') characterises ClTST2 and its upstream regulator, not ClSWEET3 or ClLCYB — so the draft bundled three genes under one paper that covers one of them. Two corrections to the suggestion: the accession it gave for ClTST2, MF497324, is a Marquandomyces marquandii fungal ITS sequence, not watermelon; the real record is KY367352.1, /gene=TST2, product 'tonoplast sugar transporter 2', protein ATQ36703.1. And Citrullus lanatus does have NCBI Gene records (185 of them), though none is named TST, SWEET or LCYB, so the practical conclusion stands: identity has to come from GenBank.

superseded.why: Not characterised in PMID 29118248. ClSWEET3 needs its own entry and its own paper; ClLCYB is flesh colour, a separate trait. Removed here rather than left implying evidence they do not have.
